items: Article 243K specifically empowers the State Election Commission for Panchayat elections.
Questions frequently test who appoints the commissioner; remember it is the Governor.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The State Election Commission is established under Article 243K of the Indian Constitution.
The commission is responsible for conducting elections to local Panchayat bodies.
Members/Commissioners are appointed directly by the Governor.
